record.question: The characteristic Xray energy used in mammography:
record.explanation: Answer A: 15-20 keV. Mammography commonly uses low-energy characteristic X-rays in roughly the 17–23 keV range; 15–20 keV is the closest option. Source/context note: Characteristic energy depends on target/filter and selected technique; range in the stem is approximate. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mammo; https://www.dicomstandard.org/current. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
